| # SID - Routine Control (0x31) {#sid---routine-control-0x31-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the service related to Routine functional unit - Routine Control.

 

Definition and Short description as per ISO 14229-1:

 

  ----------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Service           Description
  Routine Control   The client requests to start, stop a routine in the server(s) or requests the routine results.
  ----------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Routine Control service is used by the client to execute a defined sequence of steps and obtain any relevant results.

There is lot of flexibility with this service but typical usage may include functionality such as erasing memory,resetting or learning adaptive data, running a self-test, overriding the normal server control strategy, and controlling a server value to change over time including predefined sequences (e.g., close convertible roof).
